policies.title: Policies
policies.intro: A state, district or police station may make a rule stricter than the unit above it, never looser. Every change keeps who made it and why.
policies.saved: Saved. The stricter value now applies.
policies.caption: In force at your own station

import.title: Load existing records
import.intro: Load FIRs, then their arrests, chargesheets, seized items (evidence register) and notices, from an old register or system as CSV files. Load the FIRs first: the other files are matched to the FIR number and the accused already in the system. The file is checked row by row first and nothing is added to the cases until a person approves it. Existing records are never changed. Use fictional data until your department has a data agreement.
import.undone: The batch was undone and its {things} removed.
import.language: Language of the complaint text (FIR files)
import.matched: {rows} rows. Columns were matched by name; change any that are wrong. Fields marked * are required.
import.summary: {status}. {total} rows: {ok} ready, {warning} ready with something to check, {error} with errors (skipped), {duplicate} already in the system (skipped).
import.approveText: {n} rows will be added as new {things}. Rows with errors and records already there are skipped. Personal details stay in the system only once approved; the checking copy is erased.
import.authority: Authority for this load (order or letter, at least 10 characters)
import.loadedLine: Loaded {n} {things}, approved by {by} on the authority “{authority}”.
import.none: No file has been loaded yet.
